parameters.content:
## Workflow B · Multi-stage matching
**Stage 1 – SQL pre-filter (all pairs, milliseconds).** One set-based query joins this batch's users with every active product on the numeric rules. Products with no qualitative notes are matched right here, with no LLM.

**Stage 2 – profile grouping + cache.** Survivors whose product has qualitative rules are grouped into coarse profiles (employment · income band · score band). The LLM is asked once per *(product, profile)*, not per user, and verdicts are cached in `llm_decisions`, so the next upload re-uses them.

**Stage 3 – LLM verdicts.** One Gemini call per product (all its profiles in one prompt). Verdicts are expanded back to users with SQL.

LLM calls scale with **products**, not users × products.

parameters.query: SELECT batch_id FROM upload_batches WHERE status IN ('ingested', 'matched', 'notified') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

-- Mark the batch as matching and clear leftovers from an interrupted earlier run.
WITH cleared AS (DELETE FROM match_candidates WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid RETURNING 1)
UPDATE upload_batches SET status = 'matching', error_message = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid AND status IN ('ingested', 'matching', 'matched', 'notified')
RETURNING batch_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM cleared) AS cleared_candidates

-- Set-based filter over every (user, product) pair of this batch.
-- NULL criteria mean "not stated" and never exclude anyone.
WITH bu AS (SELECT * FROM users WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid),
ap AS (SELECT * FROM loan_products WHERE is_active),
survivors AS (
  SELECT bu.user_id, ap.product_id,
         ap.eligibility_notes IS NULL AS rules_only,
         profile_key(bu.employment_status, bu.monthly_income, bu.credit_score) AS profile_key
  FROM bu
  JOIN ap ON (ap.min_monthly_income IS NULL OR bu.monthly_income >= ap.min_monthly_income)
         AND (ap.min_credit_score   IS NULL OR bu.credit_score   >= ap.min_credit_score)
         AND (ap.max_credit_score   IS NULL OR bu.credit_score   <= ap.max_credit_score)
         AND (ap.min_age            IS NULL OR bu.age            >= ap.min_age)
         AND (ap.max_age            IS NULL OR bu.age            <= ap.max_age)
         AND (ap.allowed_employment IS NULL OR bu.employment_status = ANY (ap.allowed_employment))
),
-- Products whose rules are fully numeric: a survivor IS a match. No LLM needed.
rule_matches AS (
  INSERT INTO matches (user_id, product_id, batch_id, match_stage, reason)
  SELECT user_id, product_id, $1::uuid, 'rules', 'Meets the income, credit score, age and employment criteria'
  FROM survivors WHERE rules_only
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING   -- never email the same user about the same loan twice
  RETURNING 1
),
-- Products with qualitative rules: park the pair for the LLM stage.
candidates AS (
  INSERT INTO match_candidates (batch_id, user_id, product_id, profile_key)
  SELECT $1::uuid, s.user_id, s.product_id, s.profile_key
  FROM survivors s
  WHERE NOT s.rules_only
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matches m WHERE m.user_id = s.user_id AND m.product_id = s.product_id)
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT $1::uuid                                         AS batch_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM bu)::int                   AS users,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM ap)::int                   AS products,
       ((SELECT count(*) FROM bu) * (SELECT count(*) FROM ap))::int AS pairs_total,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM survivors)::int            AS pairs_after_sql,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM rule_matches)::int         AS rule_matches,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM candidates)::int           AS llm_candidate_pairs

nodes.name: Stage 2 · Profiles without a cached verdict

parameters.query:
-- Collapse candidate pairs into (product, profile) groups, and skip every group
-- the LLM has already judged for the current wording of the product's rules.
SELECT c.product_id, p.lender, p.product_name, p.eligibility_notes,
       md5(p.eligibility_notes) AS notes_md5, c.profile_key, count(*) AS users
FROM match_candidates c
JOIN loan_products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN llm_decisions d
       ON d.product_id = c.product_id AND d.profile_key = c.profile_key
      AND d.notes_md5 = md5(p.eligibility_notes)
WHERE c.batch_id = $1::uuid AND d.product_id IS NULL
GROUP BY c.product_id, p.lender, p.product_name, p.eligibility_notes, c.profile_key
ORDER BY c.product_id, c.profile_key

nodes.name: Build one LLM request per product

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO llm_decisions (product_id, profile_key, notes_md5, eligible, reason, model)
SELECT product_id, profile_key, notes_md5, eligible, reason, $2
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
     AS d(product_id int, profile_key text, notes_md5 text, eligible boolean, reason text)
ON CONFLICT (product_id, profile_key, notes_md5) DO UPDATE
  SET eligible = EXCLUDED.eligible, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, model = EXCLUDED.model, decided_at = now()
RETURNING product_id

-- Expand cached (product, profile) verdicts back to individual users, record
-- per-stage numbers on the batch, and clear the temporary candidate rows.
WITH llm_matches AS (
  INSERT INTO matches (user_id, product_id, batch_id, match_stage, reason)
  SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, c.batch_id, 'llm', d.reason
  FROM match_candidates c
  JOIN loan_products p USING (product_id)
  JOIN llm_decisions d ON d.product_id = c.product_id AND d.profile_key = c.profile_key
                      AND d.notes_md5 = md5(p.eligibility_notes)
  WHERE c.batch_id = $1::uuid AND d.eligible
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
),
groups AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT (product_id, profile_key)) AS n FROM match_candidates WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid
),
cleared AS (DELETE FROM match_candidates WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid RETURNING 1)
UPDATE upload_batches
SET status = 'matched', updated_at = now(),
    stats = stats || jsonb_build_object('matching', $2::jsonb || jsonb_build_object(
      'llm_profile_groups', (SELECT n FROM groups),
      'llm_matches', (SELECT count(*) FROM llm_matches),
      'candidates_cleared', (SELECT count(*) FROM cleared)))
WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING batch_id, stats -> 'matching' AS matching
